project.name: Gateway Scholar
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Warm editorial academic authority with paper-like surfaces, forest green trust cues, selective muted gold highlights, and refined serif-sans typography contrast.
project.designRead: Academic support landing / MSc & PhD STEM students / editorial trust and supervisor credibility / medium-low density / avoid generic SaaS gloss

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: Deep forest green carries trust, structure, and all major calls to action.
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: Soft ivory neutrals dominate large surfaces; muted gold is an explicit premium highlight requested by the user and should be used sparingly for dividers, proof cues, and emphasis.
colorSystem.stateColors: Not emphasized in this landing page.

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Rounded editorial panels with soft pill buttons; cards feel tailored and premium rather than playful.
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Playfair Display for headings and Inter for interface, navigation, buttons, and body text.
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: Generous vertical rhythm with calm section breaks, wide breathing room, and strong alignment lines.
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: Glass-tinted ivory cards, proof chips, badge-like notes, premium CTAs, and structured content blocks.
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Paper-like surfaces with soft shadows and fine warm borders; no heavy neon or glossy tech effects.
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: Editorial hero photography, clean line icons, and subtle premium highlights.
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: Measured, refined hover lift and fade-up reveals rather than loud motion.

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Editorial, premium, warm, and trustworthy academic landing page with one polished long-form homepage.

productContext.productType: Academic editing and supervisor-style thesis support service

pages.title: Home
pages.businessScenario: Premium landing page for Gateway Scholar academic editing and thesis support.
pages.visualNorthStar: Make the page feel like an elite academic advisory service: warm, authoritative, human, and immediately trustworthy.
pages.compositionPattern: Editorial cover layout with layered proof notes and alternating evidence blocks.
continuityAnchors: serif headline plus sans interface pairing
qualityRisks: hero copy could feel dense if hierarchy is weak
service blocks must avoid generic SaaS-card sameness

pages.title: Services
pages.businessScenario: Public services overview page for thesis, journal, formatting, and figure support.
pages.visualNorthStar: Structured editorial service architecture with calm authority and restrained conversion.
pages.compositionPattern: Alternating editorial panels and content stacks.
continuityAnchors: serif headline plus sans interface pairing

pages.title: Figures & Tables
pages.businessScenario: Specialist page for figure polishing, table cleanup, and publication-ready visual preparation.
pages.visualNorthStar: Make technical visual support feel precise, premium, and editorially dependable.
pages.compositionPattern: Proof-led feature sequence with supporting detail stacks.
continuityAnchors: serif headline plus sans interface pairing
qualityRisks: visual claims need concrete proof framing

pages.title: Register Your Project
pages.businessScenario: Lead capture page for students or researchers registering an editing or thesis-support project.
pages.visualNorthStar: Lower submission friction while preserving premium trust and academic seriousness.
pages.compositionPattern: Form-led conversion layout with adjacent reassurance content.
continuityAnchors: serif headline plus sans interface pairing
qualityRisks: trust copy must not sound generic

pages.title: Book a Call
pages.businessScenario: Consultation booking page for prospective clients seeking project fit and timeline guidance.
pages.visualNorthStar: Create calm, concierge-style scheduling confidence with minimal friction.
pages.compositionPattern: Scheduler-first composition with supporting advisory notes and assurances.
continuityAnchors: serif headline plus sans interface pairing
qualityRisks: booking page can feel sparse without supporting context
calendar embedding assumptions may limit layout flexibility

pages.title: Contact
pages.businessScenario: Direct contact page for enquiries, project clarifications, and support follow-up.
pages.visualNorthStar: Feel personal, responsive, and credible without losing the premium editorial tone.
pages.compositionPattern: Compact contact stack with channel cards and reassurance notes.
continuityAnchors: serif headline plus sans interface pairing
qualityRisks: too many contact options may dilute the primary action
utility content could feel visually under-designed

pages.title: Policies
pages.businessScenario: Consolidated policy overview page covering service terms, conduct, and usage expectations.
pages.visualNorthStar: Present legal and operational policy content with clarity, calm structure, and editorial polish.
pages.compositionPattern: Long-form legal content frame with anchored sections and summary callouts.
continuityAnchors: serif headline plus sans interface pairing
qualityRisks: dense policy text may overwhelm scanning
summary callouts must not distort legal meaning

pages.title: Privacy
pages.businessScenario: Privacy disclosure page explaining data handling, storage, and client confidentiality expectations.
pages.visualNorthStar: Reassure users about confidentiality and stewardship through elegant, readable privacy communication.
pages.compositionPattern: Disclosure-led legal layout with concise summaries above detailed sections.
continuityAnchors: serif headline plus sans interface pairing
qualityRisks: privacy summaries could oversimplify compliance details

pages.title: Cookies
pages.businessScenario: Cookie policy page outlining tracking categories, consent expectations, and browser control options.
pages.visualNorthStar: Make consent-related information transparent, calm, and easy to scan.
pages.compositionPattern: Structured policy explainer with category breakdowns and control guidance.
continuityAnchors: serif headline plus sans interface pairing
qualityRisks: browser guidance must stay current and specific
